subject: Next steps — procurement & PO path for Hearthbridge pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Miller <lauren.miller@hearthbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + procurement questions (Hearthbridge pilot)

Hi Lauren — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can get procurement and finance moving on the pilot: 

Call summary (2-min):
- Pilot scope: 3 production endpoints (chat+embeddings), 90-day pilot, low-volume proof of concept to validate latency and cost.
- Success criteria: <10% latency regression vs baseline, token cost within estimated range, no data exfil concerns.
- Key people you mentioned: Rajesh (procurement), Sofia Lee (security), and your internal PM team.

Items we need to land before we hand to contracts/procurement:
1) Economic buyer / PO owner: please confirm the person who signs/owns the PO and the approximate PO value range (ballpark USD).
2) Procurement cadence: do you require 30/45/60 net invoicing? Any standard PO template we should expect?
3) Security evidence: you mentioned SOC 2 and network docs — does a 1–page SOC2 summary + link to our audit artifact suffice or do they need the full report?
4) Billing contact & AP email for invoices.

I've attached a first-pass SOW for timeline context and a short price sheet so Rajesh can see numbers. If you'd like, I can loop Rajesh into a 20-min call next week to confirm PO mechanics.

Proposed next step: if you can reply with the procurement contact and invoice cadence today, I’ll schedule a short intro with Rajesh + Ben (finance lead) to align on PO/invoice flow.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments referenced: hearthbridge-sow-draft.pdf, redwood-price-sheet.xlsx
From: Lauren Miller <lauren.miller@hearthbridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:28:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement questions (Hearthbridge pilot)

Thanks, Vanessa — good recap and very timely.

Answers inline:
1) PO owner / economic buyer: Rajesh Patel (Head of Procurement) will own the PO. Ballpark pilot spend ~USD 24k–30k depending on final tiering.
2) Invoice cadence: 30 days net is our default. We can do a single consolidated invoice for the pilot month.
3) Security evidence: Procurement typically wants the SOC2 summary + either a secure link to the full report or an NDA before we share the full audit artifact. Sofia (security) usually reviews the summary first.
4) AP/billing: ap@hearthbridge.com for invoices; CC finance@hearthbridge.com if helpful.

Please loop Rajesh and Sofia when you have the SOW & pricing finalized. A short 20-min call next week works — I’m available Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Lauren Miller
VP Product Operations | Hearthbridge Health
lauren.miller@hearthbridge.com
